I interact daily with open-source 5G cores — **SD-Core (Aether)**, **Free5GC**  and **Open5GS**. There's also a fair bit of commercial 5G Cores such as the **Huawei** and **Cumucore** one. These don't fit neatly in the lists above but are very relevant to my day-to-day work.

## To Be Learned (and/or deepened)

- ![[network.svg|20]]  Traefik (for cluster networking)
- ![[podman.svg|20]]  Podman
